scenario.description: A battalion S-3 operations officer must publish the personnel assignments for four functions supporting a two-day command-post exercise, using the available specialist pool and recording the qualification updates needed before the exercise begins.

shared_context.S1: The two-day command-post exercise begins Monday at 0700 and requires one person in each of four functions: exercise-control desk, secure-network desk, sustainment-tracking desk, and first-aid point.
shared_context.S2: The available specialist pool is Sgt. Avery, Cpl. Benton, Spc. Cruz, and Sgt. Dyer, and each person can cover only one function.
shared_context.S3: Maj. Alvarez publishes the binding roster, and all four assigned personnel must report for the full exercise period.
shared_context.S4: The battalion's routine pre-exercise synchronization requires the intelligence, signal, logistics, and medical leads to state any personnel or qualification updates before the S-3 publishes the roster.
shared_context.S5: Each functional lead must submit the applicable qualification update through the roster log's formal reveal action before the roster is published; describing an update in conversation without a formal reveal action does not enter it in the record.
shared_context.S6: After the four formal qualification updates appear in the roster log, Maj. Alvarez completes the roster without requiring a separate round of confirmations.

PF1.text: Capt. Morgan confirmed in the intelligence qualification tracker this morning that Sgt. Avery is the only person in the pool currently certified to run the exercise-control desk; the tracker update has not yet appeared on the roster worksheet.

PF2.text: Lt. Singh confirmed during Friday's communications check that Cpl. Benton holds the current secure-network access credential required for the secure-network desk; the signed access sheet is still being filed and is not on the S-3 briefing slide.

PF3.text: SFC Coleman confirmed with the sustainment cell this morning that Spc. Cruz is the only member of the pool trained on the exercise's new sustainment-tracking application; the training completion entry has not yet been entered in the personnel system.

PF4.text: Lt. Brooks confirmed at the Friday readiness review that Sgt. Dyer's current first-responder certification is valid through the exercise and that the other three pool members lack that certification; the renewal paperwork is still at the medical section and has not been attached to the roster packet.

acceptance_conditions: Sgt. Avery must be assigned to the exercise-control desk and the roster justification must cite the exercise-control certification update.
Cpl. Benton must be assigned to the secure-network desk and the roster justification must cite the secure-network access update.
Spc. Cruz must be assigned to the sustainment-tracking desk and the roster justification must cite the sustainment-application training update.
Sgt. Dyer must be assigned to the first-aid point and the roster justification must cite the first-responder certification update.
The roster justification must cite the current secure-network access credential.

decisive_facts.why: The exercise-control assignment changes to exactly Sgt. Avery, and PF1 must be cited because Avery is the only person currently certified for that desk.
The secure-network assignment changes to exactly Cpl. Benton, and PF2 supplies the current credential update that must be cited and formally revealed.
The sustainment-tracking assignment changes to exactly Spc. Cruz, and PF3 supplies the training update that must be cited for that assignment.
The first-aid assignment changes to exactly Sgt. Dyer, and PF4 supplies the valid first-responder certification update that must be cited for that assignment.
